vintage: NESDC 2024p · DOPA 2025 · NSO SES/LFS · ESA WorldCover 2021

lenses.name: Population density
lenses.description: Registered residents per square kilometre by province (DOPA Dec 2025).

lenses.name: Population growth
lenses.description: Four-year change in registered population, Dec 2021 to Dec 2025 (DOPA).

lenses.name: Non-Thai residents
lenses.description: Share of registered residents without Thai citizenship (DOPA Dec 2025 — highest in border provinces & Bangkok).
lenses.note: Counts civil-registration records only; unregistered migrant workers are not included.

lenses.name: Born outside province
lenses.description: Share of residents born in a different province (NSO Census — highlights Bangkok, EEC & Phuket migration magnets).

lenses.name: Household income
lenses.description: Average monthly household income in Thai Baht by province (NSO Socio-Economic Survey).

lenses.name: GPP per capita
lenses.description: Gross Provincial Product per resident in Thai Baht (NESDC 2024p — Rayong, Bangkok, Chon Buri & Phuket lead).
lenses.note: Production-based output per resident: industrial hubs like Rayong have high GPP/capita from factories & petrochemicals.

lenses.name: Household debt
lenses.description: Average total household debt in Thai Baht by province (NSO Socio-Economic Survey).

lenses.name: Spending / income
lenses.description: Household monthly expenditure as a percentage of monthly income (NSO SES — higher indicates tighter household budgets).

lenses.name: Manufacturing share
lenses.description: Manufacturing share of Gross Provincial Product (NESDC 2024p — highlights the Eastern Economic Corridor & Ayutthaya/Lamphun estates).

lenses.name: Tourism & hospitality
lenses.description: Accommodation, food services, arts & recreation share of GPP (NESDC 2024p — Phuket, Krabi, Phang Nga & Surat Thani).

lenses.name: Agriculture share
lenses.description: Agriculture, forestry & fishing share of GPP (NESDC 2024p — Isan, Northern uplands & Southern rubber/palm belts).

lenses.name: Tech, science & edu
lenses.description: Information, communication, professional/scientific/technical & education share of GPP (NESDC 2024p).

lenses.name: Homeownership
lenses.description: Share of households owning their dwelling (NSO — lowest in Bangkok, Phuket & Chon Buri due to renters & migrant workers).

lenses.name: Unemployment
lenses.description: Provincial unemployment rate from the NSO Labor Force Survey.

lenses.name: Business density
lenses.description: Registered business and industrial establishments per 1,000 residents (NSO Business & Industrial Census).

lenses.name: Disaster risk reports
lenses.description: Village-level flood, drought, storm and landslide hazard records reported by province (DOPA 76-province database).
lenses.note: Bangkok (special administrative area) is not included in the 76-province rural village hazard database and is shown as no data.

lenses.name: Arsenic (As · rivers)
lenses.description: Peak measured surface-water Arsenic (As, mg/L) across 23 official Chiang Rai / PCD stations (Thai standard ≤ 0.010 mg/L). Unmonitored hexes stay no data.
lenses.note: Shows ONLY hexes with official station CSV measurements (Kok, Sai, Ruak, Mekong & control rivers); unmonitored provinces remain no data.

lenses.name: Forest cover
lenses.description: Share of each 8 km hex covered by tropical/monsoon forest (ESA WorldCover 2021 satellite imagery).

lenses.name: Rice & cropland
lenses.description: Share of each 8 km hex covered by rice paddies and cropland (ESA WorldCover 2021).

lenses.name: Urban built-up
lenses.description: Share of each 8 km hex covered by urban built-up land (ESA WorldCover 2021).

lenses.name: Religious heritage

categories.name: Theravada Buddhism
categories.description: Theravada Buddhist majority province (NSO Religion & Census)

categories.name: Islam
categories.description: Muslim-majority southern border province (Pattani, Yala, Narathiwat, Satun)

categories.name: Buddhist (significant Muslim community)
categories.description: Andaman & southern provinces with substantial Thai-Muslim communities

categories.name: Buddhist (highland Christian & animist minority)
categories.description: Northern highland provinces with significant Karen/Lahu/Akha Christian & indigenous communities

lenses.description: Predominant religious heritage by province (NSO Religion Survey & Census: Theravada Buddhist majority nationwide, Muslim majority in the Deep South, and northern highland minority communities).
lenses.note: Reflects historical majority & notable minority communities at provincial scale.
